content: Nub I Ha Panayawi I Yabom
Yaka lan etega Yehoba i baek al Nowa elana i ba, “Heyan sauga ya gamwaliyaa, ya kitewa owa maisem wam pagan i sapu. Inoke alomwau am heniheni ku na ku ulutuk wagaa.
Bwasumu gegewel bolo bosowaina powon, ali gewi seben, aloliyau ge lagoliyau, nu ahel. Bwasumu gegewel bolo nige bosowaina powon, eluwa eluwa, aloliyau ge lagoliyau, nu ahel.
Ge bwasumu gegewel bolo hi youyou, ali gewi seben, aloliyau ge lagoliyau, nu ahel. He nu ahel alomwau nuku ulutuk wagaa, inoke bwasumu tomaha ona bahi etega ni momowasi panayawiya.
Lan seben ya ni mowasi, yaka na ba lan poti ge bulin poti kehe ni laulau. Inoke bugul gegewel yawaliliya gaganina bolo ya ginolil, na pwamowasel panayawiya.”
Inoke Nowa bugul gegewena i ginol i ola Yehoba wana baaba.
He Nowa wana baliman 600 te nub i ha.
Yaka alonau lagona, natunau ge lagoliyau, hi ulutuk wagaa nub hi lou luwan.
He avaliyau bwasumu bolo hi nawanawa, bolo hi youyou ge bolo hi yawayawal—bolo bosowaina powon ge bolo nige bosowaina powon.
Bwasumu gegewel o, eluwa eluwa, tau ge yova, avaliyau hi ulutuk wagaa i ola Yabowaine wana baaba.
Lan seben i mowasi, yaka panuwa i tub ge nub i ha.
He liwanina i ola hiwe. Nowa wana baliman 600, weikena eluwana ana lan sebentin-ina elana, wewel bwabwatana i sani heem bilibili gamwanaa, ge labulabum i mwapwela kehe i maligin laulau.
Yaka lan poti ge bulin poti kehe i mimi laulau.
Lan toto o elana Nowa alonau lagona, natunau Semi, Hami ge Yapeta, aloliyau lagoliyau hi ulutuk wagaa.
He avaliyau bwasumu sosokal tomaha ge tomaha, bwasumu totounuwal tomaha ge tomaha, bwasumu bolo hi yawayawal tomaha ge tomaha, ge bwasumu bolo hi youyou tomaha ge tomaha.
Bugul gegewel bolo hi yanayana yoho, eluwa eluwa, tau ge yova, avaliya Nowa hi ulutuk wagaa,
i ola Yabowaine wana baaba. He sauga Nowa i ulutuk, inoke Yehoba waga ana nog i kaus.
Lan poti ge bulin poti nub i haha ya. Wewel iyaka i bwata nabi, inoke waga i ota hin.
Wewel iyoho i bwabwata heheya, yaka waga i otaota wewel pwatanaa.
Wewel iyoho i bwabwata heheya, yaka oya i yabomwil,
oya i heluwan ana miha i ola 7 mita.
Bugul gegewel panayawi pwatanaa hi aliga—bwasumu bolo hi youyou, bolo totounuwal, bolo bekikil ge bolo kekeisi ona, ginebi ge gamagal.
Bugul gegewel bolo hi yanayana yoho ge hi miminaa bilibili pwatanaa hi mowasi.
Yehoba bugul gegewel yawaliliya gaganina, gamagal, bwasumu bolo hi nawanawa, bolo hi yawayawal ge bolo hi youyou, i pwamowasel. Nowa alonau ge alonau bolo wagaa ya te hi mwal.
Nub I Mowasi
Lan ali gewi 150 wewel iyoho i bwata panayawi i yabom.
